card.name: Drug names in interaction effect statements
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after the name of an affected drug in drug-interaction text, where a drug's levels or dose are said to be reduced, changed or adjusted. Often the next words are exposure, dose, or plasma levels.

modes.label: Inside the affected drug's name
modes.description: Middle pieces of a drug name that is the object of a change in exposure or dose.

modes.label: Words after the drug name
modes.description: Words such as concentrations, production, or drugs that follow a drug name in an interaction effect.

modes.description: Commas or small words in phrases that compare drug levels or say no adjustment is needed.

card.plain: It fires on a drug's name or the words right after it when the text says another drug changed its levels or dose.
